title: Contract Term, Suspension Limits and Removal Charges on Micro Market Agreements
content:
The life of an Unattended Micro Market Program agreement is governed by figures printed against its market format: the initial term, the written notice needed to end it, the charge for ending it before the end of the term, the charge for taking the fixtures and kiosk out, the suspended days allowed in one contract year, the shortest suspension the format accepts, the notice needed to reopen, and the monthly charge while the market stands suspended.

| Market format | Initial term, months | Termination notice, calendar days | Early removal charge, USD | Equipment removal charge, USD | Suspended days allowed in a contract year | Shortest suspension, calendar days | Reopening notice, calendar days | Standby charge, USD each month |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cooler & Snack Wall | 12 | 30 | 450 | 350 | 30 | 7 | 3 | 45 |
| Compact Micro Market | 24 | 45 | 1200 | 700 | 45 | 7 | 5 | 120 |
| Standard Micro Market | 36 | 60 | 2800 | 1400 | 60 | 10 | 7 | 240 |
| Fresh Food Micro Market | 36 | 90 | 4900 | 2200 | 60 | 14 | 10 | 395 |
| Expanded Campus Micro Market | 60 | 120 | 8250 | 3800 | 90 | 14 | 14 | 620 |
| Smart Store Micro Market | 36 | 60 | 12250 | 2900 | 45 | 10 | 7 | 940 |

## Hypothetical readings of the schedule

A Standard Micro Market closed off for 9 calendar days falls short of that format's shortest suspension of 10 calendar days. The same 9 days at a Cooler & Snack Wall, whose shortest suspension is 7 calendar days, is at or beyond it.

An Expanded Campus Micro Market carries the longest initial term at 60 months and the longest termination notice at 120 calendar days, and allows the most suspended days in a contract year at 90. The Smart Store Micro Market carries the heaviest early removal charge of any format at 12250 USD and the heaviest standby charge at 940 USD each month, on an initial term of 36 months.
